title: HB0894 (110th General Assembly): As introduced, requires the department of safety to promulgate rules regarding requirements for handgun safety course instruction, including qualifications of handgun safety schools and instructors, required for handgun carry permits; authorizes a permit holder to convert an eight-year permit into a lifetime permit at any time. - Amends TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2018-01-17; own version, official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514062859 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/110/Bill/HB0894.pdf; the last listed version was not archived)
provenance.note: Draft dated 2018-01-17 (Senate twin SB 269); summary says 'As introduced'. Part (b) lists items the department may not require (written test, etc.). Effective on becoming law.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-1349(a)): (a) In addition to the requirements of § 39-17-1351(e) regarding handgun safety course instruction, the department of safety shall promulgate rules that:
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-1349(a)(7)): (7) Define the minimum handgun training course curriculum, which must include safe use of a firearm, civilian use of deadly force, and current state law on when and where a civilian can carry a firearm;
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-1349(a)(9)): (9) Define a course of fire not to exceed fifty (50) rounds with at least twenty-five (25) being fired from a distance of three (3) yards or less and no rounds being fired from a distance of more than eight (8) yards; and
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1351(x)(2)): A permit holder is eligible to convert an eight-year permit into a lifetime permit at any time the person is a valid permit holder by making application pursuant to this subsection (x).
